task: Semantic constraint approval of four visible short-range metric corridor segments; not full-route traversability or collision safety

pilot.selection: Sort by image timestamp; choose 24 evenly spaced indices, including endpoints; no semantic or model-based selection
pilot.official_example: frame000104-1581624663_149: engineering projection check only; exclude its spatial block from any future test
pilot.unavailable_policy: Record missing identities; do not replace them with easier scenes

corridors.frame: gravity-aligned local forward/left/up frame from LiDAR/body transform; verify rather than infer from image appearance
corridors.prefix_note: The segment before 6 m is outside the task; acceptance never certifies travel from the current robot pose.

qualification_checks.sensor_transform_direction: Match official notebook; verify rotation and reprojection independently
qualification_checks.ambiguity_check: Propagate measured projection residual and finite surface-support uncertainty; do not use arbitrary perturbed calibration as ground truth
qualification_checks.failure_policy: Stop model expansion and document measurement/geometry qualification failure; do not claim transferred mechanism

semantic_policy.definition: Fraction of evaluable corridor ground area covered by task-prohibited visible semantic labels
semantic_policy.ontology_source: official benchmarks/SalsaNext/train/tasks/semantic/config/labels/rellis.yaml; no claim that allowed mud or grass is physically traversable
semantic_policy.unknown_policy: Void, sky, unsupported ground, occlusion and unmapped IDs are unknown; never map them to allowed terrain.

baseline.provenance_requirement: ImageNet initialization and retraining on the frozen spatial training partition unless the released checkpoint's entire training/validation region is disjoint from all external evaluation regions

statistics.default_evidence: external empirical validation with spatial/route group summaries and uncertainty; no IID-frame binomial guarantee
statistics.split: Freeze using geometry/timestamps only; merge revisited locations before split assignment; audit shared world-frame validity
statistics.primary_mechanism: To be locked once on development data after qualification, before calibration/test; absence of the proposed mechanism is a valid result
statistics.main_frequencies: Natural frequencies; no test selection on oracle compliance

measurement_secondary.reference: native human image labels sampled on the same geometric support
measurement_secondary.coarsening: one 4x4 area-averaged prohibited/known mask, fixed before development; no raster search

continuation_gate: Data qualification and documented group separation must pass before any baseline training or final-test inference
